chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Abi Ayyub, from Abi 'Ubaydah and al-Halabi, from Abi 'Abdillah عليه السلام, who said:

He was asked about a man who killed his wife by mistake while she was in labor at the point of childbirth. He عليه السلام said: "He must pay the blood money of five thousand dirhams, and for that which is in her womb he must pay a ghurrah: a male servant or a female servant, or forty dinars."

key_terms.أَرْبَعُونَ دِينَاراً: an alternative monetary compensation equal to forty dinars
key_terms.الدِّيَةُ: the prescribed blood money payable for wrongful killing
key_terms.خَمْسَةُ آلَافِ دِرْهَمٍ: the specified amount of diyah due here for the woman
key_terms.غُرَّةٌ: the prescribed compensation for the fetus
key_terms.وَصِيفٌ: a male servant given as compensation
key_terms.وَصِيفَةٌ: a female servant given as compensation

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a man accidentally kills his wife while she is in labor and the fetus also dies?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning accidental killing of a wife who was in labor. It specifies the diyah for the woman and an additional compensation for the fetus in her womb, showing the legal recognition of both lives in cases of wrongful death.
